summary: The trace shows a hospital staffing calculation task that follows the same patterns as inventory calculations (coverage days ≈ DOH, understaff date ≈ OOS, shift blocks ≈ pallets). The key new lessons are: (1) Boolean values must be explicitly Python `bool` type when writing to Excel—integers like `1` appear as numbers not TRUE/FALSE; (2) Two-sheet output pattern (all results + flagged items only) is reusable; (3) The existing skill's calculation patterns generalize to staffing/capacity planning domains. Updating the existing skill to cover these patterns.
